AgentsColumns: Click the gear to choose the columns you care about — tags, owner, or the date of the last activity.
AgentsCreate: Creating an agent means describing a job, not just opening a chat window.
AgentsCreateInstructions: AI Instructions set its role, tone, and main tasks — that is what shapes every answer.
AgentsCreateKnowledge: Add files as a knowledge base so it answers from your own content, not from general knowledge.
AgentsCreateModel: Pick the model it runs on, and switch on the MCP tools your admin has connected.
AgentsFilter: Filters narrow the list down when the name alone is not enough.
AgentsFilterTags: Tag your agents by team or purpose, then filter by a tag — or by owner and member.
AgentsInfoPanel: The info panel is where you decide who may use an agent.
AgentsInfoPanelHistory: The history shows what changed in the agent, and when.
AgentsInfoPanelMember: The info panel shows who else uses this agent and what has changed in it.
AgentsInfoPanelMemberRoles: See every member and the access they hold, so you know whom to ask for a change.
AgentsInfoPanelMembers: Invite members, or copy a link that works for people already in your workspace.
AgentsInfoPanelViewOnly: Give view-only access and a person can read the results of other people's chats without touching the setup.
AgentsIntro: An AI agent is an assistant you set up once and reuse — not a throwaway chat.
AgentsIntroResults: Whatever an agent generates in a chat is saved to its Result tab automatically.
AgentsIntroShare: Share an agent with your team and use it across your rooms.
AgentsIntroTabs: Each agent holds its own chat, a knowledge base built from your files, and its results.
AgentsIntroUser: An AI agent is an assistant your team has already set up for you to use.
AgentsIntroUserAccess: You see the agents you were given access to; their owner decides who may use each one.
AgentsItem: Every row is an agent you can act on without opening it.
AgentsItemContextMenu: The three dots open all actions: edit the agent, invite people, duplicate it.
AgentsItemMemberMenu: The three dots open what is available to you: open the agent, or copy a link to it.
AgentsItemOpen: Click the name to open the agent and start chatting with it.
AgentsItemPin: Pin the agents you use daily — up to ten can stay at the top.
AgentsQuickAccess: Recent keeps the agents you opened lately at the top, so you don't scroll for them.
AgentsQuickAccessFavorites: Star an agent and it stays in Favorites, right above.
AgentsSearch: Find an agent by name — results update as you type.
AgentsSearchScope: Search covers agent names, not the messages inside their chats.
AgentsTrash: Deleted agents land in Trash, so a wrong click is not the end. Restore one from there, or empty Trash to free up space.
FeatureAgentAccess: You get the agents that were shared with you, with the model and tools already chosen.
FeatureAgents: Set an agent's role, tone, and tasks once, then let your whole team put it to work.
FeatureChat: Ask an agent about your files in chat, and let it save what it produces for you.
FeatureControl: Choose the model each agent runs on, and control who is allowed to use it.
FeatureKnowledge: Add documents as a knowledge base and answers come from your own content.
FeatureUseAgents: Each agent already knows its role and tasks — pick the one that fits and start working.
